_comment: triage-v2 deterministic classification rules. Stdlib-only classifier: tools/triage/classify.py. Category rule order is load-bearing (first match wins); priority and evidence are computed independently per spec. v2 = v1 with GAMEPLAY_SYSTEM renamed to GAMEPLAY_LOGIC (required taxonomy). Subsystem map unchanged from v1: FUN_-mass carries no namespace signal, so subsystem refinement lives in the cluster layer (knowledgegraph/triage/clusters-<snap8>.json), not here.

notes.category_order: 1) thunk/external/non-.text/third-party-name -> THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME; 2) sdk top-namespace in engine_namespaces -> ENGINE_INTERFACE; 3) vtable-slot member -> ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION; 4) singleton Get/Set/Property pattern -> GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT; 5) named in game namespaces (or game-global prefix) -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC; 6) else UNKNOWN.
notes.priority: IGNORE=thunk/external/non-.text; P0=sdk AND vtable AND decomp; P1=sdk XOR (vtable OR decomp); P2=named non-sdk in game namespaces/globals; P3=everything else resident in .text (incl. FUN_ and CRT leftovers).
notes.evidence: sdk_name -> CONFIRMED; named non-sdk (ghidra analysis) -> SUPPORTED; FUN_ with vtable slot or heuristic subsystem -> INFERRED; else UNKNOWN. Never OBSERVED/VERIFIED without trace_run/test_result.
notes.struct_assoc: Best-effort: SDK class prefix matched against normalized struct names; may be empty. caller_count/callee_count are always NULL (no xref export); never zero-filled.
notes.known_gaps: Itanium-mangled game symbols (_ZN6EditorC2Ev) match ^_Z and land THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME/INFERRED (2 rows); revisit with demangling in triage-v3. Clock/Swarm/Anim/Transform SDK namespaces have few or zero triage rows (their SDK VAs are not function entries); covered at cluster layer.
notes.v1_to_v2: Rename only: GAMEPLAY_SYSTEM -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC. No rule-order, priority, evidence, or subsystem-map change. Same snapshot hash on same inputs; projections overwritten under triage-v2.
